scope: Selected within-attempt examples from existing checkpoints and creator reports. These are not matched cross-profile preference results or new artwork reviews.

cases.title: A detached hand becomes a book grip
cases.mechanism: Test the difficult relationship in an isolated rough before carrying it into production.
cases.conclusion: The recorded receiving hand changes from detached to contacting the same book. The rest of the wording stays clear.
cases.limit: An observed local fix in Full process; it does not prove that this profile outperforms Standard.

steps.caption: After: thumb and fingers contact the book

cases.title: A local fix needs its own cleanup
cases.mechanism: Inspect the changed part, its neighbors and the whole scene; preserve a failed capture and plan one more correction.
cases.conclusion: Opening the tyre edge exposes the tool but introduces duplicate spokes. Cleanup restores single spokes and the hub; final review then accepts the corrected candidate.
cases.limit: The first correction fails. Simplified anatomy and a minor blunt tyre lip remain disclosed in the accepted result.

steps.caption: After cleanup: single spokes and clean hub

cases.title: The clipped title becomes readable
cases.mechanism: Inspect exact wording at intended size, then change the text frame and line spacing.
cases.conclusion: NIGHT is clipped in the first capture and fully visible after the correction; the invitation remains separate.
cases.limit: This fix already works in Standard. It illustrates the value of inspection, not a gain unique to the new profiles.

cases.title: More polish does not automatically win
cases.mechanism: Compare a later candidate with the retained version; keep the earlier result when independent reviews find no improvement.
cases.conclusion: Matching frames and search spacing change, but both final specialists judge the later candidate equal overall. The earlier candidate stays retained.
cases.limit: Quality acceptance remains unresolved. Verified native files and exports do not make this a final-review pass.
